title: Connection-string password: one-property twin (context) (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context:delimiter: the user:password ':' removed, so the value joins the user name; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context) and context:host-delimiter: the '@' ending userinfo replaced by '/', so the value becomes a path segment; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context). Twin of "Connection-string password: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of connection-string-psql-history: context:delimiter: the user:password ':' removed, so the value joins the user name; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context). The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
